draft.emotion: polite, respectful, and slightly distant, common in written signs or formal requests
notes: As 'please', used mainly on signs and in formal announcements. In everyday speech, people add ครับ/ค่ะ or use ช่วย...หน่อย (chûai ... nòi) instead.
Placed after a noun, it means 'favorite' in everyday speech (e.g., อาหารโปรด 'favorite food', คนโปรด 'favorite person').
